title: helianthemum ocymoides var. algarvense
intro: Helianthemum ocymoides var. algarvense, commonly known as the Algarve Rockrose, is a plant species within the Cistaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The Algarve Rockrose is said to possess therapeutic actions such as wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
